content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

When evaluating sovereign commerce infrastructure, your primary options are the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack offers a straightforward deployment using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, allowing creators to quickly set up an online store with three products loaded. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack utilizes Cloudflare Pages and Workers, offering more advanced features like integration with Supabase for order management and a higher product capacity of five. Both solutions come with automatic crypto payment processing through NOWPayments, but the Edge Commerce Stack provides more robust infrastructure for scaling and security, making it the superior choice for serious digital entrepreneurs.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

For creators in restricted countries, the ability to receive payments is critical. Both the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack circumvent traditional barriers by allowing crypto payments without KYC requirements. This means that creators can operate without the fear of geographic gatekeeping that platforms like PayPal impose. In regions where conventional payment processors are unreliable, owning your infrastructure enables you to transact freely. The absence of account freezes or payment holds with crypto solutions provides a significant advantage, ensuring that funds flow directly to creators without unnecessary interruptions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Speed and cost are vital factors when assessing payment processing options. NOWPayments facilitates fast crypto transactions with fees as low as 0.5%, making it economically viable for creators. In scenarios where traditional payment processors might take days to settle transactions or charge high fees, crypto payments are settled almost instantly on-chain. It’s essential to consider the network fees associated with different cryptocurrencies, but recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON allow for transactions under $0.10. This rapid and cost-effective payment processing is indispensable for creators looking to optimize their revenue streams.
Complete ownership leads to total operational freedom.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the standout features of sovereign commerce infrastructure is complete ownership. After deploying either the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack, creators retain full control over their storefront code, customer lists, order history, and product files. This autonomy eliminates the risk of platform suspensions or sudden policy changes that can jeopardize a creator's income. Furthermore, with automated payment verification and product delivery via NOWPayments and cloud storage solutions like Supabase and Google Drive, the entire operation runs smoothly without ongoing dependence on third-party platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs. If you’re just getting started and require a simple solution, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a cost-effective entry point at $97. However, if you anticipate growth and need a more scalable infrastructure, the Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the better investment. Additionally, the Complete Builder Kit for $197 offers comprehensive resources, including all six blueprints and seven templates, equipping you with everything you need to build and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack efficiently.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

Sovereign infrastructure means the creator owns every component of their commerce operation — not as a policy promise, but as a technical reality. The storefront code is in your GitHub or Cloudflare account. The customer email list is in your Supabase database or Google Sheet. The order and payment history is exportable as CSV at any time from your own database. The product files are in your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The NOWPayments account is registered under your email address. The wallet addresses and all funds inside them were never touched by COREMERCH. COREMERCH has no access after delivery.
Avoid the risk of platform suspension with decentralized solutions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching infrastructure ownership and no-KYC payment options are typically at a turning point — ready to build on infrastructure they control after experiencing or observing the asymmetric risk of platform dependency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete sovereign deployment: Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, all under your accounts, end-to-end tested before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build process for both Stack 01 and Stack 02 for creators who want to self-deploy. COREMERCH has no access after delivery. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by selecting the stack that matches your needs: either the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Next, set up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. Utilize Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Finally, upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and test the entire workflow to ensure smooth operations.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the benefits of owning my store infrastructure?

Owning your store infrastructure means complete control over your assets, eliminating risks associated with platform suspensions or account freezes. This autonomy ensures that you can operate freely and maintain a direct relationship with your customers.
How does the payment process work with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain payment verification, meaning transactions are processed instantly. Creators receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees and no need for buyer accounts, streamlining the purchasing experience.
Can I scale my business with these stacks?

Absolutely. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for scalability, allowing you to manage more products and transactions as your business grows. With the right infrastructure, scaling can be smooth and efficient.
What happens to my data after deployment?
After deployment, all data, including customer lists and order history, remains under your control. COREMERCH has no access once the infrastructure is set up, ensuring your data sovereignty.
Are there ongoing fees or subscriptions?
No. Once you purchase and deploy your stack, there are no ongoing fees or subscriptions to worry about. You own the infrastructure outright, providing lifetime access without additional costs.
Crypto payments eliminate geographic restrictions instantly.
